name: strategix-visual-mcp
title: StrategiX Visual MCP
description: Contract-first visual infrastructure for agents that produces deterministic, auditable visual artifacts with fit reports, receipts, provenance, and searchable metadata.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_visual_contract_create
canonicalTools.purpose: Create a normalized visual contract from source material, reasoning, or an artifact request.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_visual_contract_validate
canonicalTools.purpose: Validate canonical visual contracts before rendering.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_contract_repair
canonicalTools.purpose: Repair a contract that fails validation while preserving the original source intent and artifact class.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_render_artifact
canonicalTools.purpose: Render validated contracts into deterministic visual artifacts with fit reports and receipt metadata.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_render_html_artifact
canonicalTools.purpose: Package contract, rendered artifact, source digest, fit report, receipt, and metadata into self-contained HTML.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_fit_report
canonicalTools.purpose: Check artifact fit against the source contract, visual class, viewport, and accessibility constraints.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_visual_audit
canonicalTools.purpose: Inspect a visual artifact for contract drift, missing provenance, layout risk, and publish readiness.

canonicalTools.name: strategix_receipt_create
canonicalTools.purpose: Create auditable receipt metadata with input, contract, output, route, renderer, and timestamp hashes.
